admission.justification: The same help sentence stands in four subcommand parsers beside the discovery function, and two tests fail when any --config help names directory discovery or drops the user settings file; a wrong help sends a user to look for settings in the wrong folder.

applicability: The --config help of those four subcommands for the first clause; every --config help of the umbrella parser for the second.
conditions: An omitted --config in those four subcommands reads the user settings file that discover_config() reads, whatever the current directory.
exclusions: The behaviour of discovery itself, which the discovery invariant states.
Subcommands whose --config is required (the Paseo runtime commands and leaf-enclosure-start), and the dashboard help wording, for the first clause.

statement: The --config help of the memory-citations, providers-remove, removed-stores and knowledge-bootstrap subcommands states that an omitted --config reads the user settings file (agents-remember-settings.json under XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config), whatever the current directory, as discover_config() does; no --config help of the umbrella parser claims working- or current-directory discovery.
